description: A complete ability-calibration run has finished, per SPEC's private calibration model. Emitted by the calibration fitter after convergence or failure. Downstream consumers: monitoring dashboards, alert systems, downstream pipelines that depend on updated item parameters (held privately, not on this public firehose).

calibrationRunId.description: Foreign key to SPEC's private calibration-run record.

completedAt.description: UTC timestamp when the run completed.

numItemParamsUpdated.description: Number of private item-parameter records written/updated.

numAbilityStatesUpdated.description: Number of private ability-state records written.

failureReason.description: If not converged, reason for failure.
